title: De ahí en adelante: continuar una narración desde un punto

sections.content: De ahí en adelante (from then on, from that point forward) picks up a narrative right after a turning point and signals that what follows is a continuing state, not a single new event -- useful for bridging from an event already covered elsewhere into a longer period that follows it. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Ya conocemos el golpe de Estado de 1954; de ahí en adelante, Guatemala entraría en un conflicto armado interno de treinta y seis años.
items.english: We already know about the 1954 coup; from then on, Guatemala would enter a thirty-six-year internal armed conflict.

items.spanish: De ahí en adelante, la violencia en las tierras altas mayas no dejaría de intensificarse durante varios años.
items.english: From that point forward, the violence in the Maya highlands would keep intensifying for several years.

items.spanish: De ahí en adelante, la cifra de muertos y desaparecidos no dejó de crecer hasta el final del conflicto en 1996.
items.english: From then on, the number of dead and disappeared kept growing until the conflict ended in 1996.

items.spanish: De ahí en adelante, Rigoberta Menchú se convirtió en una de las voces más reconocidas en defensa de los derechos del pueblo maya.
items.english: From that point on, Rigoberta Menchú became one of the most recognized voices in defense of the Maya people's rights.

sections.content: De ahí en adelante always looks forward from a point already established in the previous sentence -- it needs that anchor, unlike desde entonces, which can stand more independently.
